properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 7 at 4:35PM EDT until August 8 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Binghamton NY
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Binghamton has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in New York...

Oneida Creek At Oneida affecting Madison and Oneida Counties.

For the Finger Lakes/seneca/oswego River...including Auburn, Auburn,
Nedrow, Geneva, Oneida, Ithaca, Ithaca, Liverpool...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Oneida Creek at Oneida.

* WHEN...From this evening to Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 11.0 feet, Flood Stage. Low lying areas in the Town of
Verona, and near Oneida Castle, flood. No homes, businesses, or
infrastructure are affected. At 11.5 feet, Water spreads across
Highland Avenue, cutting off some residences from accessing
Prospect Street. Low lying areas in the Town of Verona north of
Sconondoa Street flood as water backs up along Sconondoa Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:15 PM EDT Friday the stage was 2.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rapidly rise above flood
stage this evening to a crest of 11.8 feet. It will then fall
below flood stage late this evening.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 11.8
feet on 03/26/1963.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 7 at 11:00AM AKDT until August 8 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Yentna River including Lake Creek.

* WHEN...Until 100 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1053 AM AKDT, the river remains in moderate flood stage
after heavy rains earlier this week, but is beginning to
subside. The river crested at 22.52 ft around 8pm Thursday,
August 7th.
- For Yentna River at Lake Creek:
At 9:50am the stage was 22.3 feet.
Flood Stage is 20.5 feet.

Impacts:
At 20.5 feet: Anglers Inn & King Point Lodges will have water
in several cabins.



At 22.0 feet: McDougal's, King Point, Anglers Inn, Wilderness
Place, Lake Creek Lodge, 3-Rivers, and Cottonwood Resorts
will have water in a number of cabins with water also
encroaching the main lodge buildings.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Locations impacted include...

properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of
a building. This storm has produced large hail in Rainsville,
Langstonm and Dutton.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
